title: You found the infinite money glitch. But there's a catch.
idea: There's a catch, episode 4: the friend who never has money can copy it: one coin, an armful of hundreds, every dollar in the city; then prices explode and a pile of his money burns just to keep him warm

hook.what: Gunslinger looks into his empty wallet, the moth flying out, then holds up his one coin; the counter man's palm is out and beckons; Reaper holds out a 100 to pay for him again. The narrator's opening line ends on 'But there's a catch.'
